title: Containers, OCI Runtimes & Distroless Images
summary: Build, inspect, and troubleshoot OCI containers, containerd/CRI runtimes, multi-stage distroless images, and rootless execution contexts.
learningObjectives: Inspect running containers and OCI image layers using docker and crictl CLI workflows.
Remediate broken container image deployments suffering from ImagePullBackOff.
Deploy hardened distroless workloads running as non-root users in production.

curriculumModules.title: OCI Specifications, containerd & OverlayFS
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: The Open Container Initiative (OCI) standardizes image manifests, layer tarballs, and runtime config.json. Kubelet communicates with containerd over gRPC via the Container Runtime Interface (CRI).
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Use multi-stage builds to compile binaries in a builder stage and copy only the static binary and CA certificates into `gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot`.

curriculumModules.title: Diagnosing ImagePullBackOff & Container Startup Failures
curriculumModules.conceptSummary: ImagePullBackOff occurs when containerd cannot fetch an image manifest due to an invalid tag, missing registry Secret, or unreachable registry mirror.
curriculumModules.productionArchitecturePattern: Pin immutable OCI image digests or verified semantic tags and configure private imagePullSecrets with regional registry mirrors.

labs.title: OCI Container Runtime Inspection & Distroless Deployment
labs.scenario: Platform Security requires migrating a microservice in namespace `production` to a minimal distroless OCI image.
labs.productionContext: Distroless images eliminate shells and package managers from production containers, shrinking CVE surfaces by over 90%.
objectives: List available local OCI container images using docker images
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: distroless-api
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: distroless-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: distroless-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot

steps.title: Inspect Local OCI Image Cache
steps.instruction: Run `docker images` to inspect verified base images on the node.

steps.title: Deploy Distroless API Workload
steps.instruction: Create deployment `distroless-api` in `production` with 2 replicas using `gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot`.

validationRules.description: Inspected OCI images via docker images

validationRules.name: distroless-api
validationRules.remediation: Deploy distroless-api with image gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot in namespace production.

labs.troubleshootingGuide: Check `kubectl get deploy distroless-api -n production -o json` to confirm the image tag matches `gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot`.

labs.title: Resolving ImagePullBackOff on Production Inventory Service
labs.scenario: Deployment `inventory-api` in namespace `production` was deployed with an invalid image tag (`nginx:1.27-broken`) and is stuck in `ImagePullBackOff`.
labs.productionContext: Rapidly identifying and fixing broken OCI image references is one of the most common day-to-day Kubernetes operations.
labs.starterManifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: inventory-api
  namespace: production
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: inventory-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: inventory-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: inventory
          image: nginx:1.27-alpine

steps.title: Inspect Failing Inventory Pods
steps.instruction: Run `kubectl get pods -n production` to observe the `ImagePullBackOff` status.

steps.title: Set Verified OCI Image Tag
steps.commandHint: kubectl set image deployment/inventory-api inventory=nginx:1.27-alpine -n production

validationRules.description: Deployment production/inventory-api image updated to nginx:1.27-alpine
validationRules.name: inventory-api
validationRules.remediation: Run `kubectl set image deployment/inventory-api inventory=nginx:1.27-alpine -n production`.

validationRules.name: inventory-api
validationRules.remediation: Ensure the image tag is valid so pods transition to Running.

solutionCommands: kubectl set image deployment/inventory-api inventory=nginx:1.27-alpine -n production
labs.troubleshootingGuide: Use `kubectl describe deploy inventory-api -n production` to verify the container name (`inventory`) and image (`nginx:1.27-alpine`).

assessmentQuestions.question: Why are multi-stage builds with distroless base images recommended for production Kubernetes workloads?
options: They include a full bash shell and apt-get for live production debugging
They strip compilers, shells, and OS package managers, drastically reducing image size and CVE attack surface
They automatically disable container memory limits
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Distroless images contain only the application binary and runtime dependencies, preventing attackers from spawning shells or running package managers if a process is compromised.

assessmentQuestions.question: Which protocol does the Kubernetes kubelet use to communicate with containerd?
assessmentQuestions.explanation: Kubelet communicates with OCI-compliant runtimes like containerd and CRI-O using the Kubernetes Container Runtime Interface (CRI) over a local UNIX domain gRPC socket.
